Name: (FS) Eye Patch Accessory
Author: Multea
Description:
This is a simple mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ that turns the eye patch hat that is only available for purchase after catching all fish into an accessory.

That's basically it.

I've never modded before, so if there are any concerns or problems, I'll do my best to address them.

[b][u]You will need Fashion Sense for this to work. This is not a Content Patcher mod.[/u][/b]

Manifest.Name: Eye Patch Accessory
Manifest.Description: I just want the eyepatch as an accessory.
